verdict.rationale: Connecting a coding agent to workflow tools is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack documents no Jira, Slack, Google Drive or other connector integration in Aider. The /web command scrapes a single webpage into the chat, which is an adjacent context feature rather than a workflow-tool connector, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context
